0022600142.text: The Mavericks (2-2, 8th in the West and 2 games back in the Southwest) host the Thunder (4-0, 1st in the West and Northwest, on a four-game winning streak) in Dallas' fifth game of the season, and this is their first meeting of 2026-27 after Oklahoma City won all three matchups in 2025-26, most recently 100-87 in Dallas on March 1, 2026. Dallas is without Caleb Martin (thumb sprain), Dereck Lively II (foot surgery), Santi Aldama (knee surgery), Sergio de Larrea (knee strain), and Tarik Biberovic (heel inflammation), while Kyrie Irving (knee) and Naji Marshall (illness) are listed as day-to-day and game-time decisions. Oklahoma City is missing Alex Caruso (ankle), Cason Wallace (shoulder), Chet Holmgren (knee), Jalen Williams (leg fracture), Nikola Topic (back), Otega Oweh (Achilles surgery), and Thomas Sorber (knee), and Ajay Mitchell (ankle) is day-to-day and a game-time decision.
